title: Tôi cần đại sứ quán
summary: For asking for embassy help when a passport, document, or safety issue cannot wait.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Lead with the embassy request, then show your passport copy, phone screen, or written note.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Keep the sentence short and let the hotel desk, police counter, or helper ask for details.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi cần means I need; đại sứ quán means embassy.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Lost passport, nearest embassy, and contact embassy phrases keep the request focused.

phrases.vietnamese: Đại sứ quán gần nhất ở đâu?
phrases.pronunciation: Dai su quan gan nhat o dau

phrases.vietnamese: Xin hãy giúp tôi liên hệ với đại sứ quán của tôi
phrases.english: Please help me contact my embassy
phrases.pronunciation: Xin hay giup toi lien he voi dai su quan cua toi

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel desks, police counters, airports, clinics, and any official-help moment.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If you know your country's embassy or consulate, show the name on your phone.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Unsafe, emergency, temporary document, passport report, and police station phrases cover stronger safety needs.
